reason: No candidate has established a gain: the historical battery scores vary widely, and the last constant-bound n=512 source has correctness results only. Rank low-overhead SME scheduling and address changes first; they preserve the data layout, selectors, and FP32 reduction order. Full-tile specialization and K blocking follow, then changes that add substantial traffic or replace SME. Rank vector_access last: existing direct horizontal ZA stores already target row-major C, while the proposal adds a temporary tile and copy without evidence of an alignment advantage. The stated hardware profile provides SME and SIMD capabilities but no alignment guarantee, so rely only on unaligned-safe accesses. All rankings are hypotheses for serial measurement against fresh AC controls.
